label: Richard C. Doty
narrative: Doty is the only US counterintelligence officer to have stated on camera and on the record that he personally ran disinformation about UFOs against American civilians as part of his official duties. As an AFOSI special agent at Kirtland AFB from 1979, he authored or handled the 1980-1983 Kirtland documents concerning unexplained objects over Coyote Canyon, fed fabricated material to Paul Bennewitz, and in April 1983 showed the documentary producer Linda Moulton Howe a briefing paper purporting to describe a government programme - the 'Project Aquarius' teletype - which she was not permitted to copy. He was also a conduit in the emergence of the MJ-12 material through Bill Moore. He left AFOSI in 1988 and later served as a New Mexico State Police officer; his 321-page state police personnel file was obtained under the New Mexico Inspection of Public Records Act and published in 2021, giving the first full documentary picture of his post-Air Force career. Doty's value to this board is not that his statements are reliable - they are not, and he has repeatedly changed them - but that his existence is the proof of concept. The United States assigned a counterintelligence officer to manage the UFO information environment. He has said so. Whatever else is in dispute, that is not.
